features.name: position_depth_ratio
features.description: Relative position of the ad within the result list depth. Lower values indicate top placement.
features.expected_model_benefit: Smooth continuous signal of ad prominence useful for linear margin.

features.name: position_from_bottom
features.description: Number of slots from the bottom of the displayed list; higher means more prominent.
features.expected_model_benefit: Linear ordinal signal of ad visibility.

features.name: is_top_position
features.description: Indicator that the ad is shown in the top position slot.
features.expected_model_benefit: Sharp linear feature capturing top-slot prominence effect.

features.name: normalized_position_severity
features.description: Normalized position score scaled to [0,1] where 1 indicates the bottom of the list.
features.expected_model_benefit: Smooth normalized severity ideal for SVM margins.

features.name: log_impression
features.description: Log-transformed impression count to compress heavy-tailed distribution.
features.expected_model_benefit: Linearizes skewed impression counts for SVM.

features.name: log_keyword_id
features.description: Log-scaled keyword identifier as a smooth proxy for keyword rarity ordering.
features.expected_model_benefit: Smooth proxy of keyword space for linear projection.

features.name: log_user_id
features.description: Log-scaled user identifier to compress wide ID range.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides bounded continuous proxy for user-id grouping.

features.name: has_description
features.description: Indicator that the ad has a non-missing description id.
features.expected_model_benefit: Binary content-completeness signal useful in linear models.

features.name: title_description_consistency
features.description: Smooth similarity between log-scaled title and description ids, capturing co-occurrence pattern.
features.expected_model_benefit: Approximates linear interaction between title and description identifiers.

features.name: ad_advertiser_scale
features.description: Weighted composite of log ad_id and log advertiser_id capturing scale of advertising entity.
features.expected_model_benefit: Smooth composite providing linear projection of ad-entity scale.

features.name: impression_per_slot
features.description: Impressions normalized by depth, a smooth measure of exposure density.
features.expected_model_benefit: Continuous severity score of exposure intensity.

features.name: ad_content_richness_score
features.description: Semantic judgment of ad content richness based on presence and magnitude of keyword, title, and description identifiers, scaled to [0,1].
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides bounded interpretable richness signal complementing linear features.
